title: The Spice Factor
openingText: The factor's stall is an island of lacquered order in the steaming chaos of the port: saffron in brass tins, ledgers squared, a guard pretending to be a porter. 'Sit, sit. Saffron, escorts, secrets... everything is for sale on this coast, wizard. The only question is the price.'
dialogueCordial: Now this I can work with. To a long association!
dialogueStrained: I hear you. Whether the Combine agrees is another ledger.
dialogueHostile: Careful. Storms come without warning on this coast. So do accidents.
dialogueWalkaway: We are DONE here. The Combine will remember the discourtesy.
dialogueAccept: Pleasure doing business. The Combine keeps its ink dry and its word wet.

terms.description: A bulk contract on eastern saffron for the guild kitchens and alchemists, at 60 gold.
He wants your wizards guarding his next caravan, for free. Your run slows by 3 steps.
Which mangrove passes the syndicates watch this season. Saves 2 steps.
A buried clause: the guild owes the Combine one unnamed favor, on demand.
terms.rumorText: The Combine's contracts are famous for their generosity, and for one clause nobody remembers reading.

terms.description: He also holds charts of the drowned harbor. He'd part with them, for the right partner.
terms.rumorText: He mentioned the drowned harbor once, then folded the thought away like a chart he was saving.
